Operational definition: One sovereign state assessed separately for each virus.
Recurrent locally acquired transmission across multiple transmission seasons, or explicit current designation as endemic/established by an authoritative public-health source.
Application note: Historical evidence alone is insufficient unless current evidence supports persistence.

Operational definition: One or more temporally bounded outbreaks with locally acquired infections, without evidence meeting the established-transmission criterion.
Application note: Outbreak duration and recurrence should be documented where available.

Category/variable: Autochthonous transmission in a non-endemic setting
Operational definition: Isolated or limited locally acquired transmission outside a recognised endemic setting, without evidence of sustained establishment or a qualifying outbreak.
Application note: Designed to separate isolated local transmission from outbreaks.

Operational definition: Imported infections documented without qualifying evidence of locally acquired transmission.
Application note: Absence of reported local transmission is not proof of biological impossibility.

Operational definition: Available evidence is insufficient or materially inconsistent.
Application note: Recommended for future verified version; not present in original categorical dataset.

Operational definition: Formal national authorisation of at least one vaccine relevant to the virus and population.
Application note: Must be separated from availability and programme introduction.

Operational definition: Evidence that vaccine can be obtained in-country through private or routine healthcare channels.
Application note: Approval does not automatically establish current supply.

Operational definition: Inclusion in a publicly organised national or subnational vaccination programme.
Application note: Record programme geography and target group separately.

Operational definition: Access limited to travellers or designated risk groups rather than population-level disease control.
Application note: Should not be counted as routine population deployment.

Operational definition: Uptake among an eligible target population in a specified year.
Application note: Not assessed in this dataset and must not be inferred from licensure or programme status.

Operational definition: Each sovereign state contributes one observation within each virus-specific analysis.
Application note: Does not estimate population-level protection or burden-weighted access.

Operational definition: Categorical evidence of Aedes aegypti and/or Aedes albopictus presence, limited/sporadic occurrence, absence, or uncertainty.
Application note: Indicates ecological compatibility only; does not establish virus circulation or quantify abundance.

Operational definition: Categorical evidence relating to the Culex tritaeniorhynchus complex, integrating documented occurrence and habitat-suitability modelling.
Application note: Modelled suitability is not equivalent to confirmed entomological detection.

Operational definition: Source IDs identify the global or regional evidence used to support vector classification. Country-specific occurrence citations are not available for every jurisdiction.
Application note: Interpret row-level vector status as a harmonised evidence category rather than a direct surveillance measurement.
